chapter.verse: Ciaptehna gipa a kibelh sagihte lakah khat Tuuno in a hon ka mu a, sahing lite lakah khat in kekkia bang awging tawh, “Hong pai in!” a cih ka za hi.
Kei zong ka khuadak leh, en un, sakol kang khat om hi. Sakol tuangpa in thal khat tawi a, ama' tungah kumpi-lukhu kipia hi. Amah zong a gualzo kawm mahin a gualzo dingin kuankhia hi.
Ciaptehna gip a nihna a hon ciangin sahing a nihna in, “Hong pai in!” a cih ka za hi.

Tua ciangin sakol a dang khat hong pusuak a, a sanciik khat ahi hi. A tuangpa in mite kikal ah kithahna a pian nadingin leitung pan nopna lemna lakkhiat theih ding phalna ngah a, ama' tungah namsau a golpi khat kipia hi.
Ciaptehna gip thumna a hon ciangin sahing a thumna in, “Hong pai in!” a cih ka za hi. Ka khuadak leh sakol vom khat om a, a tuangpa in a khut sungah tawikhaibu khat tawi hi.

Tua ciangin sahing lite' laizang pana kipau ahihtuak awging khat ka za a, “Mangbuh lawhta khat ciangin denarius khat, mim lawhta thum ciangin denarius khat man hi. Tua hi a, sathau leh lengtui kisiasak kei in,” ci hi.
Ciaptehna gip lina a hon ciangin sahing lina in, “Hong pai in!” a cih ka za hi.

Ka khuadak leh sakol puang khat om hi. A tuangpa' min pen Sihna hi a, a nungah Leinuai in zui hi. Namsau tawh, kialpi tawh, pulpi tawh, leitung gamsate tawh mi a that dingin amau gel' tungah leitung seh li-ah-khat uktheihna thu kiguan hi.
Ciaptehna gip a ngana a hon ciangin biakpiaktau nuai-a om, Pasian' thu hangin leh a teci panna uh hangin thahlup a thuak mite' nunna khate ka mu hi.
Amaute awging lianpi tawh kiko uh a, “A siangtho a thutak Topa Lianbel aw, leitunga mite' tungah thukhen lo-in leh kote' sisan phu la lo-in bangtanvei om ding na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute puantual paak khatta kipia a, amau mah bangin thah a thuak ding ahi a silapihte uh leh a sanggamte uh a phazah ding a cin dongin amaute tawmvei tawlngakbeh lai ding cih kigen hi.
Ciaptehna gip a gukna a hon ciangin ka khuadak leh zinling lianpi khat om hi. Ni pen samul kigan puanham bangin hong vom a, kha pen a bupin sisan hong bang hi.
Van-a aksite zong theikung pan huihpi' sinkhiat theigah puamlaite bangin leitung ah kithehsuk zeizai uh hi.
Vantung pen laihual kizial bangin kinilkhia a, mual leh tuikulh khempeuh amau' mun tek pan kikhinkhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin leitung kumpite, ulian zaliante, galkap mangte, mihaute, mithahatte leh mi khempeuh, sila leh tualmi suakta, a vekpi-un kuahawmte' sung leh mualtung suangpite' kawmlak ah bu uh a,
mualte leh suangpite' kiangah, “Ko' tungah hong cimsuk unla kumpi-tokhom tunga a tupa' mai panin leh Tuuno' hehna panin ko hong sel un.
A hang pen amau' hehna tawh kisai ni thupi hong tung khinta a, kua in nangzo ding ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
